'''2007 Minnesota State Championship Ben Paatela DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Paatela]] at [[2007 Minnesota State Championship]].

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Ben Pustela?
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
